title: Your first encounter in noctune — web

headline: Start an
encounter.
scenes.narration: Here's how to take an appointment from recording to client follow-up in noctune. Choose New Encounter and select your patient. noctune includes general SOAP and discharge templates. You can explore community templates or create your own. For this visit, we'll use the general templates.

headline: Record or
upload audio.
scenes.narration: Record the appointment in your browser, or upload an existing audio file. Review the queued recording, then choose Process file to submit it.

headline: Give the draft
time to prepare.
scenes.narration: noctune transcribes the recording and prepares draft notes. You can leave this screen and return from the Encounters queue when the draft is ready.

headline: Review the
clinical note.
scenes.narration: Review the clinical note against the transcript and audio. Check the patient details, findings, and plan. The draft is a starting point for your clinical review.

headline: Edit, save,
and complete.
scenes.narration: Choose Edit to make corrections, then Save. When your review is finished, choose Complete. Saving an edit and completing the encounter are separate steps.

headline: Send discharge
on any account.
scenes.narration: Review your discharge instructions, then choose Send Email and Send discharge notes. Every account can send them. Without Nest, discharge emails use no reply by default. Confirm the recipient before sending; drafts are never sent automatically.

headline: Private replies
with Nest.
scenes.narration: With noctune Nest, clients can reply through a private relay address. Your personal email stays hidden, and replies return to noctune, linked to the encounter. Open Messages to follow up with the visit in context.
